entities.name: Whakapapa (Maori Genealogies)
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Maori genealogical system that traces descent lines from the gods through founding ancestors to living persons, serving simultaneously as history, law, identity, and spiritual connection. Whakapapa demonstrates how oral genealogical records can preserve centuries of demographic, political, and migration information with remarkable accuracy, confirmed by DNA evidence.
